_comment: Shape of run b1nx (2026-07, forensics in the plan's Research facts). THE case the continuity
rule exists for: K1 was re-rendered in take t2, but the cut still uses t1's K2 — which was
conditioned on the OLD K1's last frame. The clips LOOK chained (K2 does open on a K1 last
frame) and every naive check passes, but the frame it opens on no longer exists in the cut.
Anything that reports this as a continuation will hand it to a colour-matching stitcher and
produce a visible jump the user was told would be seamless.
Ids only — no filesystem paths leave the server (see serializeContinuity).
